ideas.title: 3 things nobody tells you
ideas.hook: "Nobody tells you this before you start…"
ideas.concept: A punchy list of 3 hard-won lessons — talking to camera with quick b-roll cutaways. This is a template: ask your AI to write real ones for you.

shots.angle: Talking head, phone at eye level, window light on your face
shots.action: Deliver the hook straight to camera — confident, lean in slightly
shots.say: Nobody tells you this before you start. Here are 3 things I learned the hard way.

shots.angle: Close-up b-roll of your hands / product / workspace
shots.action: Show the thing while the voiceover plays over it
shots.say: Number one: start before you feel ready — you never will.

shots.angle: Walking shot, camera slightly low, moving toward you
shots.action: Walk and talk, keep the pace up
shots.say: Number two: boring consistent work beats the big flashy move every time.

shots.angle: Talking head, tighter framing than shot 1
shots.action: Land the last point and the call to action
shots.say: Number three: your first try will be rough. Post it anyway. Follow for more.

ideas.caption: 3 things I wish I knew earlier 👇 Which one hit hardest?
